sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_meta" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "value" TEXT NOT NULL) WITHOUT ROWID;
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "value_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL) WITHOUT ROWID;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "physical_disks" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "serial" TEXT, "model" TEXT, "size_bytes" INTEGER, "bus_type" TEXT, "identity_confidence" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (identity_confidence IN ('reliable', 'weak', 'unknown')), "user_confirmed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "first_seen_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_seen_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sources" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('external_hd', 'internal', 'usb_stick', 'memory_card', 'phone', 'folder')), "volume_guid" TEXT, "volume_serial" INTEGER, "volume_label" TEXT, "filesystem" TEXT, "volume_size_bytes" INTEGER, "physical_disk_id" INTEGER REFERENCES physical_disks(id), "marker_id" TEXT, "device_id" TEXT, "device_model" TEXT, "root_rel_path" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "last_mount_path" TEXT, "connected" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_connected_at" INTEGER, "total_bytes_last" INTEGER, "free_bytes_last" INTEGER, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "forgotten_at" INTEGER, "device_serial" TEXT, "device_platform" TEXT);
CREATE INDEX ix_sources_volume_guid ON sources (volume_guid)
CREATE INDEX ix_sources_volume_serial ON sources (volume_serial)
CREATE INDEX ix_sources_device_id ON sources (device_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "scans" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sources(id), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('full', 'incremental')), "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('running', 'paused', 'interrupted', 'completed', 'cancelled', 'failed')), "coverage" TEXT CHECK (coverage IN ('complete', 'partial')), "mount_path_used" TEXT, "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "finished_at" INTEGER, "dirs_done" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "files_seen" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "bytes_seen" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "error_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);
CREATE INDEX ix_scans_source ON scans (source_id, started_at DESC)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "scan_dirs" ("scan_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES scans(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "rel_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'done', 'error', 'excluded')), PRIMARY KEY(scan_id, rel_path)) WITHOUT ROWID;
CREATE INDEX ix_scan_dirs_pending ON scan_dirs (scan_id) WHERE status = 'pending'

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "scan_errors" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "scan_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES scans(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "rel_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('access_denied', 'path_too_long', 'io_error', 'reparse_point_skipped', 'device_disconnected', 'other')), "win32_code" INTEGER, "message" TEXT, "at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "contents" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "sha256" BLOB NOT NULL CHECK (length(sha256) = 32), "size_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "media_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown' CHECK (media_type IN ('photo', 'video', 'raw', 'sidecar', 'other', 'unknown')), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE(sha256, size_bytes));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "file_instances" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sources(id), "rel_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "dir_rel_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "ext" TEXT NOT NULL, "size_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "mtime" INTEGER, "ctime" INTEGER, "attributes" INTEGER, "content_id" INTEGER REFERENCES contents(id), "hash_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (hash_status IN ('pending', 'done', 'changed_during_read', 'error', 'not_applicable')), "hashed_size" INTEGER, "hashed_mtime" INTEGER, "hashed_at" INTEGER, "last_verified_at" INTEGER, "availability" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'present' CHECK (availability IN ('present', 'cloud_only', 'unreadable', 'missing')), "integrity" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown' CHECK (integrity IN ('unknown', 'ok', 'changed', 'possibly_corrupt')), "first_seen_scan_id" INTEGER REFERENCES scans(id), "last_seen_scan_id" INTEGER REFERENCES scans(id), "missing_confirmed_at" INTEGER, "hash_error" TEXT, "device_object_id" TEXT, UNIQUE(source_id, rel_path));
CREATE INDEX ix_fi_content ON file_instances (content_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_fi_source_dir ON file_instances (source_id, dir_rel_path)
CREATE INDEX ix_fi_size ON file_instances (size_bytes)
CREATE INDEX ix_fi_hash_pending ON file_instances (source_id) WHERE hash_status = 'pending'
CREATE INDEX ix_fi_last_seen ON file_instances (source_id, last_seen_scan_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_fi_ext ON file_instances (ext)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "clock_corrections" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "make" TEXT, "model" TEXT, "body_serial" TEXT, "offset_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "years" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "period_start_utc_ms" INTEGER, "period_end_utc_ms" INTEGER, "source_ids_json" TEXT, "note" TEXT, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "undone_at" INTEGER);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "moments" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('auto', 'edited')), "name" TEXT, "start_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "item_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "media_metadata" ("content_id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES contents(id), "capture_utc_ms" INTEGER, "capture_local" TEXT, "tz_offset_min" INTEGER, "date_source" TEXT CHECK (date_source IN ('manual', 'exif_original', 'video_internal', 'filename', 'filesystem', 'none')), "date_confidence" TEXT CHECK (date_confidence IN ('high', 'medium', 'low', 'none')), "date_conflict" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "candidates_json" TEXT, "make" TEXT, "model" TEXT, "lens" TEXT, "iso" INTEGER, "aperture" REAL, "exposure_s" REAL, "focal_mm" REAL, "width" INTEGER, "height" INTEGER, "orientation" INTEGER, "lat" REAL, "lon" REAL, "duration_ms" INTEGER, "fps" REAL, "video_codec" TEXT, "audio_codec" TEXT, "bitrate" INTEGER, "software" TEXT, "extractor" TEXT, "extracted_at" INTEGER, "body_serial" TEXT, "meta_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'full' CHECK (meta_status IN ('full', 'partial', 'error')), "meta_error" TEXT, "eff_utc_ms" INTEGER, "eff_local" TEXT, "eff_offset_min" INTEGER, "eff_source" TEXT, "eff_confidence" TEXT, "clock_correction_id" INTEGER REFERENCES clock_corrections(id), "eff_year" INTEGER, "eff_month" INTEGER, "eff_day" TEXT, "eff_minute" INTEGER, "eff_weekday" INTEGER, "moment_id" INTEGER REFERENCES moments(id)ON DELETE SET NULL);
CREATE INDEX ix_mm_capture ON media_metadata (capture_utc_ms)
CREATE INDEX ix_mm_camera ON media_metadata (make, model)
CREATE INDEX ix_mm_eff ON media_metadata (eff_utc_ms)
CREATE INDEX ix_mm_ym ON media_metadata (eff_year, eff_month)
CREATE INDEX ix_mm_moment ON media_metadata (moment_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "date_corrections" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "content_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES contents(id), "capture_local" TEXT NOT NULL, "tz_offset_min" INTEGER, "note" TEXT, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "superseded_at" INTEGER);
CREATE INDEX ix_dc_content ON date_corrections (content_id) WHERE superseded_at IS NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "operations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('copy', 'reorganize_move', 'undo', 'restore', 'catalog_backup_copy')), "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('planned', 'confirmed', 'running', 'paused', 'completed', 'completed_with_errors', 'cancelled', 'needs_attention')), "dest_source_id" TEXT REFERENCES sources(id), "dest_root_rel" TEXT, "template" TEXT, "conflict_policy" TEXT CHECK (conflict_policy IN ('suffix', 'ask')), "params_json" TEXT, "summary_json" TEXT, "undo_of" TEXT REFERENCES operations(id), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "confirmed_at" INTEGER, "started_at" INTEGER, "finished_at" INTEGER);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "operation_items" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES operations(id), "seq" INTEGER NOT NULL, "src_source_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sources(id), "src_rel_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "src_instance_id" INTEGER REFERENCES file_instances(id), "expected_size" INTEGER NOT NULL, "expected_sha256" BLOB, "dst_source_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sources(id), "dst_rel_path_planned" TEXT NOT NULL, "dst_rel_path_final" TEXT, "tmp_rel_path" TEXT, "original_name" TEXT, "state" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('pending', 'copying', 'copied', 'verifying', 'verified', 'publishing', 'published', 'skipped_identical', 'failed', 'needs_attention', 'undone')), "src_sha256" BLOB, "dst_sha256" BLOB, "bytes_copied" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_error_code" TEXT, "last_error_message" TEXT, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "expected_mtime" INTEGER, "undo_of_item_id" INTEGER REFERENCES operation_items(id), UNIQUE(operation_id, seq));
CREATE INDEX ix_oi_open ON operation_items (operation_id, state) WHERE state NOT IN ('published', 'skipped_identical', 'undone')

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "operation_events" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES operations(id), "item_id" INTEGER REFERENCES operation_items(id), "at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "from_state" TEXT, "to_state" TEXT, "message" TEXT);
CREATE INDEX ix_oe_op ON operation_events (operation_id, at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "saved_filters" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "name" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "definition_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "selection_sets" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "name" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "selection_set_items" ("set_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES selection_sets(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "instance_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES file_instances(id), PRIMARY KEY(set_id, instance_id)) WITHOUT ROWID;
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tags" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "name" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "content_tags" ("content_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES contents(id), "tag_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tags(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY(content_id, tag_id)) WITHOUT ROWID;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "integrity_checks" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "instance_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES file_instances(id), "operation_id" TEXT REFERENCES operations(id), "checked_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "result" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (result IN ('unchanged', 'changed_legit', 'possibly_corrupt', 'unreadable', 'missing')), "observed_sha256" BLOB, "observed_size" INTEGER, "observed_mtime" INTEGER);
CREATE INDEX ix_ic_instance ON integrity_checks (instance_id, checked_at DESC)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "saved_scopes" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "name" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE, "definition_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE INDEX ix_moments_start ON moments (start_utc_ms)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "moment_edits" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "moment_id" INTEGER, "op" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (op IN ('rename', 'merge', 'split', 'reset')), "detail_json" TEXT, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);
